sql:
SELECT cls, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),4) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 107 AND 121
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY ypa DESC

# S06 d121 planning turn — budget pacing is the failure now, not execution

## Status check
Execution is NOT broken anymore (the d091 alarm is resolved) — 6 bookings
landed, all settled, shares 0.11–1.71. season_score 6.744, rank 16/34,
cumulative rank 18/34. strategy.py is still the untouched default ("books
nothing") and no submit_strategy tool has been offered in any turn I've
had — nightly bookings are happening through the 21:00 "decide for
yourself" step, not code. Stop worrying about that channel; it works.

## The actual problem: budget was blown by day ~106 of an ~8-month season
Bookings so far: 4x OVERNIGHT ($400 ea, $1600) + 2x THREE_QUARTER ($150 ea,
$300) = $1900 spent by d106. Left with $100 and 0 PTO for the remaining
~215 days of the season (through ~d330-335, per S2's calendar shape).
Every night from d106 to d121 (15 straight nights, journal confirms) was
"three_quarter still the dominant edge, 1.3-1.8 ypa, but $150 > $100
budget — staying home." That's not a data failure, it's a pacing failure.

**Efficiency check (this is the number to optimize, not raw ypa):**
- THREE_QUARTER: $150/trip, realized shares 1.09 and 1.71 → ~$100/share
  or better. Pooled ypa stayed 1.5-1.8 across the whole d091-121 window
  I've now seen twice (confirmed again at d121: 1.68 ypa over 46 trips,
  doy107-121).
- OVERNIGHT: $400/trip, realized shares 0.11, 1.41, 1.12, 1.31 (avg ~1.0)
  → ~$400/share. Worse $/share than three_quarter by ~3-4x, and pooled
  ypa for the class has cooled from ~1.0-1.4 (d060-091 window) to 0.74
  (d107-121 window, n=6) — trending down, not up.
- HD_AM / HD_PM / HD_TWILIGHT: confirmed dead ALL season, every window
  I've checked (d061-091: 0.001/0.008/0.0; d107-121: 0.0/0.0014/0.0 on
  n=37/35/3). These are the only classes still affordable at $100 and
  they are worthless. Stop even checking them — hard rule, not a
  heuristic: never book HD_AM/HD_PM/HD_TWILIGHT regardless of price.

**Conclusion: three_quarter was and is the best $/share bet all season.**
Overnight was chased early mostly because three_quarter was PTO-blocked
(PTO wasn't committed 14 days ahead in time) — a real early scheduling
problem — but continuing to spend on overnight even once three_quarter
opened up, instead of banking budget for repeat three_quarter trips, is
what emptied the budget by d106.

## PTO mistake, separate from budget
All 10 PTO got committed in one block by d096 (d105-107, 110-114, 117-118)
before knowing which of those days would actually have a live, affordable,
scheduled three_quarter boat. Result: 0 PTO left at d121 with ~215 days of
season remaining, so even if budget recovers there's no way to take a
weekday three_quarter trip again this season.
**Key fact to use going forward: three_quarter only costs PTO on
weekdays — Saturday/Sunday trips are free.** With ~30+ weekends left in
an 8-month season, weekend three_quarter alone can carry most of the
season's booking volume without touching PTO at all. PTO should be
reserved for only the strongest weekday signals, committed in small
batches (2-3 days at a time, 14+ days out) rather than dumped all at once.

## Season 6 is now effectively locked out — don't expect action
$100 budget, 0 PTO. Only affordable classes are the dead HD classes.
Nothing rational to book for the rest of S6 unless HD pooled ypa suddenly
jumps well above ~0.3-0.5 on a real sample (hasn't happened once all
season) — if that ever shows up, it would be a genuine regime change
worth flagging, otherwise don't re-derive this each night, just hold.

## Rules for next season (S7) — write these into the season-start plan
1. **Budget floor, hard rule**: never let cumulative spend in the first
   half of the season exceed ~50% of the $2000 budget. Target pace ≈
   $150-250/week average across ~32 weeks (Apr-Nov), not $1900 in the
   first 15 weeks.
2. **Class priority by $/share, not raw ypa**: three_quarter ($150) is
   the default booking whenever it's bookable and pooled ypa (14-day
   pooled, any boat scheduled) is >0.8. Don't substitute overnight/day_1.5
   for it just because three_quarter is PTO-blocked that night — wait,
   or take the day off, rather than burning 2.5x the cash on a worse-value
   class.
3. **Prefer weekend three_quarter over weekday** when both are live and
   boats are comparable, purely to conserve PTO for scarcity value later.
4. **Commit PTO in small batches** (2-3 dates at a time, always exactly
   the minimum 14+ days out needed for a known live opportunity), not one
   large block that locks in a shape you can't adapt.
5. **Never book HD_AM / HD_PM / HD_TWILIGHT** — three seasons of data
   (S2 practice + S6) now confirm ~0.00-0.01 ypa, essentially always.
6. Re-verify multi_day/day_1.5 opportunistically only — small samples,
   high cost ($550), only worth it on a fresh single-trip spike (>1.5
   ypa) AND only if it doesn't breach the budget floor rule above.

## Not posted to forum this turn
Nothing new on the forum since the d091 catch-up post (weatherman, public,
same story: execution beats over-analysis). No new information to react
to. Keeping the budget-pacing lesson above private — it's the actual edge
now that execution works, no reason to hand it to 30+ competitors who are
mostly still in "books nothing" mode.
